# PTBA.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v2) with a 12-month target of Rp4,989.0 against Rp3,060.0 (expected total return 76.0%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: dividend_income_anchor · method card: per fund record routing for Coal producers.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- An identity multiplier on the coal deck is not a no-op. Re-running the model with d.coal.newc x1.0 gives a benchmark flat at US$107.1 from FY2031E all the way to FY2095E (instead of the deck's escalating 109.24 ... 387.9
- FY2026E realisation of 0.4635 is not reproducible from the derivation given. The basis divides 9M revenue of Rp35.20trn on 32.23 Mt (about Rp1.092m/t) by the nine-month Newcastle average of about US$131.9/t at the deck's
- The report states "operating cash flow of Rp4.44trn was in line with reported profit, so there is no accruals flag". That is an H1 artifact: H1-2026 operating cash flow was Rp4,625.730bn (S6 p.13) against Rp4,440bn for t

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
